subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
A marine construction staging area will be established near Canfisco Bay.
Hours of operation 1400 UTC to 0400 UTC Monday to Saturday until Nov 8
On site vessels monitoring VHF channel 16, 71 and 74.
Mariners are advised to avoid the marine equipment staging area and navigate via the main channel. 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1341-26
